item.title: Review of the ONE+ HP 18V Cordless Advanced WHISPER Series Stick Vacuum (PBLSV719K and PBLSV719B)
item.description:
Dear god Ryobi is bad at naming shit.

Ok, so we needed a new vacuum so you get a vacuum review. That does seem to be how this site is working for now, as the only time I ever seem to post something is to post a review.

So, what did I get? Well, I got the Ryobi PBLSV719K, otherwise known as the gobbledygook I copypasta’d into the title. It’s a stick vacuum. And not a bad one at that. As you can probably guess, it uses the ubuiquitus Ryobi 18v batteries.
